name: f1 different class rhs
f2 same class rhs
f3 same class, const return
code:
class B:
    def __init__(self, x): self.x = x
    def __add__(self, o): return 7
print(B(1) + B(2))

name: f4 same class, return self
code:
class B:
    def __init__(self, x): self.x = x
    def __add__(self, o): return self
print((B(1) + B(2)).x)

name: f5 same class, no new object
code:
class B:
    def __init__(self, x): self.x = x
    def __add__(self, o): return self.x + o.x
print((B(1) + B(2)))
